name: A Plague Upon Thee
label: Quest
description: A Plague Upon Thee: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
You set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you done it, friend? Have you released the termites? The Light help us if the Scarlet Crusade were able to hold onto both the mill and Hearthglen. They should have neither. They're just capitalizing on the victims of the last war and should be put down like rabid animals!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! Thank you, friend! You've done it! My father's spirit can now rest and I can live in peace.
Thank you again. If there is anything I can do for you, please, just ask.
